title: Quảng cáo tín dụng mua trước trả sau · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support restricting the promotion of deferred-payment services for everyday purchases, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Small instalments can make several ordinary purchases look cheaper than their combined repayment obligations really are. I support restricting misleading deferred-payment promotion, while preserving clear factual information for borrowers who can afford the repayments.

Supporters argue that advertising restrictions can reduce impulsive borrowing. Presenting a purchase as several small instalments can conceal the cumulative burden of multiple commitments. A shopper could overlook the combined repayments attached to several inexpensive items. The marketing concern is a mismatch between the small payment shown at purchase and the larger pattern of obligations the borrower must manage afterwards. Several small instalments may look manageable in isolation while their combined repayment schedule exceeds what a household can afford after essential spending.

Opponents warn that removing advertisements does not address opaque fees or weak affordability checks. A broad ban can also remove useful price comparisons, pushing careful borrowers towards less transparent sellers or more expensive credit without reducing their need to spread essential costs. When factual comparisons disappear with persuasive adverts, borrowers may be less able to distinguish a genuinely affordable instalment plan from a costly substitute. Rules should distinguish persuasive promotion from neutral comparisons, allowing standardised information on total repayments to remain accessible. Even without advertising, borrowers can encounter unclear fees and obtain several loans whose combined repayments are unaffordable. A restriction on promotion leaves these lending practices untouched, so the underlying debt risk may persist after the most visible marketing has disappeared. Clear total-cost disclosure and proportionate lending standards should accompany marketing rules. Total-cost information and lending checks address the remaining mechanism directly, rather than expect an advertising restriction to reveal fees or establish the customer's repayment capacity. Protection should be judged through total-cost understanding, affordability checks and debt outcomes, rather than assume that fewer advertisements alone prevent harmful borrowing. Preventing repeated impulsive commitments is more valuable than unrestricted promotion, but hiding factual credit information would unnecessarily penalise careful borrowers.
Marketing limits should make the full commitment visible rather than merely remove adverts; clear costs and credible affordability checks are what turn reduced persuasion into safer borrowing.

commonMistakes: Cho rằng mọi trả chậm đều có hại bất kể khả năng trả.
Chỉ hạn chế quảng cáo mà không xét phí và tổng nợ nhiều khoản.
Nhầm tác hại khoản vay còn tồn tại với vấn đề mới do chính lệnh hạn chế gây ra.
review: Task Response: Kết luận trả lại cả hai cách nhìn và quyết định của người viết; không cần chia đều số câu nhưng phải giải thích thực chất cả hai phía. Đã xử lý phản biện “Removing advertisements does not address opaque fees or weak affordability checks.” chưa?

Coherence & Cohesion: đã giải thích cơ chế và điều kiện? Không coi mọi trả chậm là xấu hoặc người vay thiếu trách nhiệm. Có người quản lý được dòng tiền; vấn đề là cách trình bày che tổng nghĩa vụ và kiểm tra khả năng trả yếu.
Lexical Resource: dùng “cumulative burden” đúng nghĩa “gánh nặng cộng dồn của nhiều nghĩa vụ hoặc chi phí”, không thay thuật ngữ chính xác bằng từ hoa mỹ?
Grammar: can/could/may thể hiện khả năng chứ không chứng minh quan hệ nhân quả; mệnh đề điều kiện có nêu đúng điều kiện trong tình huống không?

focus.mechanism: Chia giá thành kỳ nhỏ làm khoản mua trông dễ chịu, nhưng nhiều cam kết cộng lại vượt ngân sách. Ví dụ nhiều món rẻ nhấn mạnh gánh tích lũy, không chỉ vấn đề một món xa xỉ.
